action.prompt: A `git push` just completed in this worktree. Execute the code-review skill against the most recently pushed commits. Gather the diff with `git log --oneline -10` plus `git diff @{upstream}..HEAD` (or `git diff <base-branch>...HEAD` if no upstream), then produce the structured Critical/Important/Minor verdict.
